title: Memory Shelf
description: Shape contract for .opencode/memory-shelf.yaml - the central RAG index that agents read to locate conspects, analyses, ADRs, specs, and architectures (DIA-180 A2). Validated by scripts/validate-memory-shelf.sh at `make test-config`; the script's embedded structural checks mirror this schema so hosts without the jsonschema pip package still get gate coverage. The shelf entries are agent-written via text tools, so the contract is deliberately strict: unknown keys and malformed dates fail the gate instead of silently degrading lookups.

rag_bases.description: Reserved for future RAG base registrations; empty today (2026-08).

shelfEntry.description: One shelf record. Every section shares the same entry shape: name + description + path + created are required; status/task_ref/id/title/date are the optional extras observed in the real shelf (2026-08-15 inventory). created must be an ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD); the validator normalizes PyYAML's native datetime.date objects to ISO strings before validation so both quoted and unquoted spellings pass.
